text.p: Singapore Airlines said on Tuesday it plans to expand cargo co-operation with Lufthansa Cargo AG by increasing the frequency of their joint freighter services between Frankfurt and Singapore.
These services will also link with Lufthansa Cargo hub at Sharjah in the United Arab Emirates, SIA said in a statement.

From October 31, two additional B747 freighter services will be launched each Thursday and Friday, it said. These services are in addition to the two current freighter frequencies operated by the two airlines between Singapore and Frankfurt.

The above additions will increase the number of joint freighter services operated by both airlines between Frankfurt and Singapore to four a week, offering up to 400 tonnes of weekly freighter capacity in each direction, SIA said.
